parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It extends from the hinge to the ear area.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of durable plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the head, ensuring the eyeglasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint to fold inward or open outward, similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses. The lenses are made of polycarbonate, and the frame is plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position for vision correction or protection and connects to the legs via hinges.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the legs rotate around the hinges; it serves as the central structural component.
